events.title: Demo Update 1.0.1 is Live!
events.summary: Demo Update 1.0.1 is Live!We’ve just updated the demo for Unsound Love to version 1.0.1! :DUnsound Love is an open-world experience, and the demo already lets you explore a large part of it. However, there’s still a lot more in development! events.title: The DEMO is out!
events.summary: The demo for Unsound Love is out now.Unsound Love is an open-world escape room game where you have to figure out everything on your own. All the sounds in the game — from your footsteps to the monsters’ screams — are created using musical instruments. Our team currently consists of four people, two of whom are musicians, and we plan to bring even more musicians on board in the future.
